name: @amxv/holocron
description: Private owner-authenticated text and selected UTF-8 file sharing with literal Mac clipboard MCP writes

scripts.check: bun run check:cli && bun run check:raycast && bun run check:site
scripts.check:cli: bun run typecheck && bun run build && bun run test && bun run package:smoke && bun run installer:smoke && bun run source:check && bun run check:api
scripts.ci:all: bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun install --cwd raycast --frozen-lockfile && bun install --cwd site --frozen-lockfile
scripts.secret:regression: bun run build && node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/secrets.test.ts tests/secret-enrollment.test.ts tests/secret-relay.test.ts tests/secret-cli.test.ts
